# AnthroForge topology worker bundle

This directory contains the locked Windows x64 CPython 3.11 wheel used only by
the background topology worker. The wheel is verified against `manifest.json`
before extraction into a temporary runtime directory.

- `pyinstantmeshes 1.0.0`: BSD-3-Clause
- Underlying Instant Meshes: BSD-3-Clause

The user does not need to install Python packages or Instant Meshes separately.
